## Requirements: Pages public export safety and metric freshness

Phase 2-B3 child of #1782: harden the **standalone public Pages artifact contract** and display honest metric freshness/coverage. This work is unblocked by #1690 and #1664 and must not claim Agent Run→PR causal provenance.

Current `pages/scripts/project.mjs` whitelists exported fields, but `validateProjection` only blocks a handful of forbidden JSON key names. Free-text Issue titles, registry provider strings, and embedded URLs/host paths need a defense-in-depth release gate. The current artifact also exposes build time without an explicit freshness status for the older `metrics.json` and `agent-metrics.json` source measurements.

- Add deterministic, versioned **public projection release validation**: strict bounds on Issues, PRs, Agent roster, cross-reference and Run metadata counts; require source repository, exact SHA and canonical GitHub link identities, safe dates and finite public metrics; reject non-whitelisted/private source fields, absolute filesystem paths, private addresses, credential/token-like material, raw prompt/transcript/tool/checkpoint payloads before publication.
- Sanitize unsafe untrusted Issue/PR titles and registry-provided human text at projection time without publishing their disallowed content; fail closed when a constructed export would leak it. Preserve canonical GitHub links, safe title text and meaningful source identifiers.
- Record separate metric source ages/statuses (fresh/stale/unavailable) derived from the **source generated_at**, not the Pages build time; display these states on relevant Agents/Repository UI without claiming offline/incomplete data is zero.
- Add deterministic positive/negative fixtures for malicious strings, PII/secret markers, private IP/path/URL, forged extra fields, truncation, NaN/Infinity, stale timestamps, source-SHA drift and unknown-vs-zero. Preserve independent `pages/` code/build/design.
- Expand existing `pages-overview` / `pages-evidence` browser assertions for stale/missing source and text safety. No new privileged writer or runtime API.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Versioned standalone exported Pages projection has an explicit bounded allowlist and fails release if a sensitive or untrusted payload escapes sanitization; positive source-sanitization and negative tests are deterministic.
- [ ] SC-02 Agents/Repository display source-derived freshness and observation coverage; stale/absent metrics are not conflated with current or zero, and generated/export times are distinct.
- [ ] SC-03 Deterministic fixtures reject raw prompt/transcript/tool/checkpoint secrets, private IP/path/host/URL, injected fields, unsafe source link identity and malformed numeric/window values; normal public GitHub links and titles remain usable.
- [ ] SC-04 Independent Pages build, Quality/Case Smoke and existing stable Pages browser E2E pass on exact PR HEAD without import/copy of product `web/` or changes to orphan writers/SC projectors.
